articles.title: Bitcoin risks worst October in 12 years as tech sell-off spreads to gold
articles.snippet: Bitcoin circled $77,000 as crypto markets navigated US stock-market downside, while the gold price fell to its lowest in a year.

articles.title: Will gold’s ‘infinite mint bug’ make Bitcoin more valuable?
articles.snippet: A US fusion startup says it has turned mercury into gold. Could a potential increase in the gold supply strengthen Bitcoin’s claim to be a better form of digital gold?

articles.title: Binance hack could accelerate shift to DEXs: Standard Chartered
articles.snippet: Standard Chartered’s Geoffrey Kendrick said the breach could accelerate a shift toward decentralized trading and strengthen his case for Uniswap’s UNI token reaching $100 by 2030.

articles.title: Polymarket Pauses Trading as Prediction Market Investigates Security Incident
articles.snippet: Polymarket restricted trading and paused relayer actions as users report funds leaving their accounts. A suspected attacker wallet holds about $2.65 million in POL, per Arkham data.
